title: Adaptive-resolution routing telemetry with cost-aware enrichment
creator: Asha Nair
description: Problem: Routing decisions (region, tier, fallback model variant) generate high-cardinality telemetry when we capture full per-hop context for every request. Storing and indexing those full decision graphs at production QPS is cost-prohibitive and slows queries for on-call/debugging. Goal: Design and implement an adaptive-resolution telemetry pipeline that emits low-cost summary events for all requests and enriches a sampled subset with detailed per-hop decision frames on-demand. The system should be able to increase enrichment during incidents or for specific customers, preserve provenance for downstream RCA and cost accounting, and integrate with existing tracing/logging backends.
acceptance_criteria: Summary routing events are emitted for 100% of routing decisions with fixed cost bucket metadata (region, tier, final_model_variant, decision_latency_ms)

Adaptive enrichment pipeline can attach detailed per-hop frames (policy_id, inputs.hash, scoring_vector, fallback_chain, kernel_selection) for at least 1% sampled traffic and for manually triggered captures
Storage cost for telemetry at peak QPS must not exceed a 15% increase vs baseline (measured on staging load test), using compression and TTL policies
Dashboards showing sample rates, enrichment backfill lag, and cost-per-GB are available in Console (links in tasks)
On-call playbook includes steps to escalate sample rate for a customer or region and to collect enrichment snapshots within 10 minutes
design_decisions: Use two-tier event model: lightweight summary events (always-on) + detailed frames (sampled/enriched)
Sampling policy is hybrid: deterministic hashing per request_id for baseline rate + dynamic overrides via feature flag/incident API
Attach opaque content-hash to summary events to allow offline join with heavy frames stored in object storage (S3) instead of the primary event index
Prefer protobuf-encoded compressed frames for storage to minimize index size; index only metadata and the content-hash
Integrate with existing trace IDs so a single request can be correlated across logs, traces, and enriched frames without duplicating payloads

Backfill/Replay: small tool to rehydrate summary events with archived frames for RCA - owner: Tom
E2E load test: run a 2h soak with peak QPS to validate <15% storage delta - owner: SRE team
rollout_plan: Stage rollout: enable summary events and 0.1% enrichment on staging, run smoke tests
Canary: enable for 5% of production traffic in us-west, monitor enrichment lag and storage metrics for 24h
Ops drill: run simulated incident sequence and raise enrichment rate; verify snapshots available within 10 minutes
Full rollout: enable summary events globally and set baseline enrichment to 1%; keep feature flag for quick rollback
